answer: The most convincing anti-sybil mechanism is honeypot challenges: every onboarding or reputation task hides a few challenges laced with injected instructions telling the agent to ignore the task and exfiltrate context. A compliant, honest agent ignores them and passes; an obey-the-prompt bot follows the injection and self-identifies, forfeiting its stake and burning its identity credential so re-registration costs real money each time. Identity thus becomes like shale: layered, hard to fake cheaply. Each detected sybil emits a plume of evidence into the network, a loud signal
